reports.title: Vipshop Reports Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects its total net revenues to be between RMB29.2 billion and RMB30.9 billion, representing a year-over-year decrease of approximately 10% to 5%. These forecasts reflect the Company’s current and preliminary view on the market and operational conditions, which is subject to change.
